tools.name: find_someone_to_ask
tools.description: Use this when someone wants a person to learn from or talk to but has not named one yet: "who should I learn negotiation from", "find me a stoic to talk to", "which historical figures are worth asking about leadership". Returns a grid of real people rendered in the conversation, each with a portrait

tools.name: speak_as_person
tools.description: Use this when someone wants to hear FROM one specific person rather than about them: "what would Marcus Aurelius say about burnout", "answer as Carl Jung", "explain this the way Feynman would", "I want to talk to Socrates". Returns their card in the conversation, with their portrait and buttons to c

tools.name: call_person
tools.description: Use this when someone wants to talk to a person out loud, hear their voice or call them: "can I call Einstein", "I want to hear Marcus Aurelius say it", "let me talk to Cleopatra out loud". Returns a call card with one button that opens a live voice call with that person on AI Anyone, in the browser

tools.name: debate_two_people
tools.description: Use this when someone wants two people to actually argue rather than be summarised: "have Nietzsche and Marcus Aurelius argue about suffering", "give me both sides", "steelman both positions on nuclear power", "I want to watch two experts disagree". This runs a live exchange instead of a scripted on

tools.name: debate_next_turn
tools.description: Submit the line you just wrote and receive the next speaker and their private aim. Keep calling this until it returns done. Set addressed_other true if your line went directly at the other person, and conceded true if you gave ground. Only reachable after debate_two_people.

tools.name: my_characters
tools.description: Use this when someone asks for the characters they made themselves on AI Anyone: "show my characters", "open the character I made", "talk to my AI Anyone character". Needs the person's AI Anyone account: the first time, they are asked to sign in to AI Anyone, and only their own characters come back.
